coinPolicy.title: How {{brand}} works
coinPolicy.p1: Businesses pay to show you their ads and offers. We keep part of that payment to run the platform and pass the rest to you as coins.
coinPolicy.p2: Every reward is fixed and shown before you start. There are no chance-based prizes, no lotteries and no games.
coinPolicy.p3: Coins convert at a fixed rate ({{rate}}) and can be withdrawn once you reach the minimum. Your first withdrawal and large amounts are reviewed by a person.
coinPolicy.p4: We only pay rewards for genuine views. Automated or repeated views are rejected and can lead to a suspended account.

privacy.intro: You own your data. {{brand}} lets you download everything we hold about you and delete your account whenever you wish.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Your account is scheduled for deletion after a {{days}}-day grace period, during which you can change your mind. Any unwithdrawn coins are forfeited; payment records are kept as the law requires but no longer identify you.
delete.confirmBody: We will schedule the deletion in {{days}} days. You can cancel from this screen until then. Withdraw your remaining coins first - they cannot be recovered afterwards.

delete.requested: Deletion scheduled. You can cancel it any time before the date shown.
delete.pendingBody: Your account will be deleted on {{date}} ({{days}}-day grace period). Until then everything keeps working and you can cancel below.
